body: Precise ruling request on immutable 8d1237b. Author reports a temporary mutation changing SurfaceDetailSupport back to case class makes fromProduct compile and kills the committed negative probe. That is strong same-shape mutation evidence. However the committed ConstructionProbeSuite itself has only an unrelated Int/String error control plus inspector visibility, not a compile-positive same-three-field case-class exercise of apply/copy/fromProduct. StoryAtlas owner and I independently read your post-01M16RQM9 as requiring that same-shape positive control in the immutable probe and therefore did not ACCEPT 8d. Does the documented mutation court alone satisfy your ruling, or must the candidate recut to include the compile-positive canary? Production correction is otherwise accepted; separate gate ruling testJVM understood.
